pre.speaker: Vance
lines: One road, and men on it who have decided the road is theirs.
They will want coin first and blood second. We are not carrying enough of the one to avoid the other.

victory.speaker: Kest
lines: They ran before the last of them fell. That is not the same as being finished with us.
Whatever they were guarding, it was not this road.

defeat.speaker: Briar
lines: Back to the treeline. Nobody is dead who will not walk again by morning.
We go again — and this time we do not let them choose the ground.

pre.speaker: Briar
lines: The water is shallow and the far bank is high. Whoever waits up there gets the first shot and the last word.
Cross fast or do not cross at all.

victory.speaker: Ottoline
lines: They knew we were coming. Someone told them, and it was not a guess.
Wash the ford water off before it sets. We are not stopping here.

defeat.speaker: Vance
lines: Fall back across. The river does not care who holds it.
We learn the bank and we take it properly.

pre.speaker: Ottoline
lines: A watchtower with nobody watching, and a fire someone banked an hour ago.
There is a hexer inside. I can feel the shape of what they have been doing in there.

victory.speaker: Kest
lines: Whatever the hexer was, it was not a brigand. Brigands do not keep a ledger.
Vance is reading it. He has gone quiet, which is worse than shouting.

defeat.speaker: Ottoline
lines: That was not a fight we lost. That was a fight we walked into badly.
Change what you carry. The tower will still be there.

pre.speaker: Vance
lines: The bridge is half down and the half that stands is held by people who broke it.
Nobody destroys their own crossing unless they are keeping something on the other side.

victory.speaker: Briar
lines: The marauders were paid. Not in loot — in coin, minted, and not from any purse on this road.
One camp left, and it is the one they were all being paid out of.

defeat.speaker: Kest
lines: Off the span. Falling is not a way to win an argument.
We come back at it with something they have not seen us do yet.

pre.speaker: Vance
lines: Everything since the toll road has been someone else's errand, run by someone else's hand.
The warchief is the last knuckle of it. Not the hand. But it is what we can reach today.

victory.speaker: Ottoline
lines: It is over, and it is not finished. The ledger named a place none of us have been.
For tonight, the road is a road again. That will do.

defeat.speaker: Vance
lines: Out. Now. We do not die in someone else's camp for someone else's reasons.
We came this far by changing. Change again, and we come back.
